title: Social Media Profiles block
description: List of social media links with optional header, card styling and grid/list layout

hasCard.description: This block's own full-width background, on the outer container and behind each item. Distinct from layout.appearance, which is the shared inset-card box.

headerAlign.description: Text alignment for header and description

viewType.description: Visual layout of the profile icons. bands/tiles/discs are 1:1 ports of the Classic sMedia linear/square/circle templates.

transparent.description: Drop the per-profile accent disc behind each logo, leaving the platform artwork on the block's own surface.

colorMode.description: brand: Classic brand-coloured disc behind a white glyph (legacy parity).
